test.create_query: CREATE TABLE promql_rollup_ts ENGINE = TimeSeries SETTINGS samples_rollup_steps = '5m, 1h', recent_samples_ttl_seconds = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO promql_rollup_ts (metric_name, tags, samples) SELECT 'rollup_metric', map('instance', toString(number), 'dc', toString(number % 8)), arrayMap(step -> (toDateTime64(1000800 + step * 15, 3), (sipHash64(number, step) % 1000000) / 1000), range(5760)) FROM numbers_mt(2000)
test.query: SELECT * FROM prometheusQueryRange('promql_rollup_ts', 'sum(rollup_metric)', 1004400, 1087200, '1h') SETTINGS time_series_prefer_rollup_tables = 0 FORMAT Null
